description: Deterministic regex patterns for Phase 0 pre-scan. Matches are reported directly without agent confirmation.

patterns.name: hardcoded_aws_key
patterns.description: AWS access key ID pattern detected in source code.

patterns.name: hardcoded_generic_secret
patterns.description: Generic secret/token assignment pattern (key = 'value' with high entropy).

patterns.name: hardcoded_private_key
patterns.description: Private key material embedded in source.

patterns.name: eval_exec_usage
patterns.description: Use of eval() or exec() with potentially dynamic input.

patterns.name: pickle_loads
patterns.description: Deserialization via pickle.loads or pickle.load without trust boundary.

patterns.name: yaml_unsafe_load
patterns.description: YAML deserialization via yaml.load without SafeLoader.

patterns.name: os_system_subprocess_shell
patterns.description: Shell command execution with potential for injection.

patterns.name: sql_string_concat
patterns.description: SQL query constructed via string concatenation or f-string.

patterns.name: md5_sha1_password
patterns.description: Weak hash algorithm used in password or credential context.

patterns.name: jwt_none_algorithm
patterns.description: JWT decode without algorithm restriction (allows 'none' algorithm attack).

patterns.name: innerHTML_assignment
patterns.description: Direct innerHTML assignment with potentially untrusted content.
